_doc: What bots do with map marks (Update 04 section 3, DECISIONS T-069; gravelight/bots/bot_mark_orders.gd + bot_mark_task.gd). A mark for a bot becomes its order: one per bot, a high-weight utility action (actions.json mark_order) whose input is BotMarkTask.value(). Revives win over it (revive weight 1.25); a bot that was pulled away says so when it comes back.
_queue_doc: An order it can't afford yet waits this long while the bot earns (then it gives up and says so). Every other order also ends after order_s.
_go_doc: A bot sent to a spot waits there this long after arriving, then goes back to following.
_deliver_doc: Buy for teammate: the bot drops the gun at the player's feet within this; until then it holds it (the player can take it from the bot).
_reserve_doc: Scrip a bot keeps back on an order (0: the player asked, so it spends what it has).

value._doc: BotMarkTask.value() by state: the mark_order action's input (0 = it doesn't run: waiting for Scrip, done).

best_bot._doc: Choosing 'Any bot' for a purchase: closest by path among those not down or reviving; one who can afford it beats one who can't; short_penalty_m metres added per 100 Scrip short for the rest.

_bench_doc: An Armorer's Bench mark without a slot picked: the bot takes the first of these it hasn't fitted and can afford (else saves for the cheapest).

lines._doc: VO categories (VO_SCRIPT section 19). short_buckets: the amounts a bot says it is short (rounded up to the next one; above the last: MARK_SHORT_LOTS).
